outcome_definition: AKI within 7 days after CABG, meeting ≥1 stage 1 criterion from KDIGO, AKIN, or RIFLE definitions (adjudicated)
source_location: Table 2; Results — Primary, Secondary and Exploratory Outcomes
source_evidence: Table 2 reports AKI 16/71 vs 29/74 at 7 days; Results text states AKI 22.5% vs 39.1% (RR 0.57, 95% CI 0.34–0.96).

outcome_definition: Reported effect for AKI within 7 days after CABG (composite of KDIGO, AKIN, or RIFLE)
source_location: Table 2; Figure (article highlights) and Results text
source_evidence: Unadjusted RR 0.57 (95% CI 0.34–0.96) for AKI within 7 days.

outcome_definition: AKI within 7 days after CABG by RIFLE criterion (stage 1 or higher)
source_evidence: Table 2 shows RIFLE AKI 9/71 vs 13/74.

source_evidence: Table 2 lists KDIGO AKI stage 1: 13 (18.3%) vs 24 (32.4%). Results text notes most AKI were stage 1.

source_evidence: Table 2 shows KDIGO AKI stage 2: 3/71 vs 4/74.

outcome_definition: AKI within the first 7 days after cardiac surgery according to KDIGO 2012 criteria (serum creatinine and urine output).
source_evidence: AKI occurred in 5/25 (20%) in the empagliflozin group vs 20/30 (66.7%) in control; absolute difference 46.7% (95% CI −69.7 to −23.6).

outcome_definition: KDIGO-defined AKI within 7 days after surgery: increase in serum creatinine ≥0.3 mg/dL within 48 h, or ≥1.5× baseline within 7 days, or urine output <0.5 mL/kg/h for 6–12 h.
source_evidence: AKI occurred in 111/392 (28%) in the dapagliflozin group and 205/392 (52%) in the placebo group during the first 7 postoperative days.

outcome_definition: KDIGO-defined AKI within 7 days after surgery (as above). Reported relative risk.
source_evidence: Relative risk for AKI dapagliflozin vs placebo: 0.54 (95% CI, 0.45–0.65).

outcome_definition: Incidence of perioperative acute kidney injury defined by KDIGO criteria
source_evidence: AKI incidence 40.7% in dapagliflozin vs 41.0% in control; RR 0.99; 95% CI 0.69–1.44; P = .977.
extraction_notes: Raw event counts not reported; percentages and RR provided.

outcome_definition: Cardiac surgery-associated AKI Stage ≥1 within 7 days post-surgery by KDIGO creatinine criteria (increase ≥0.3 mg/dL within 48 h or ≥1.5× baseline within 7 days, or RRT within 7 days)
adjustment_variables: Overlap-weighted propensity score using: LVEF category, chronic arterial hypertension, COPD, BMI, preoperative hemoglobin, preoperative serum creatinine, loop diuretic, renin–angiotensin system inhibitors, surgery type, simplified prediction index for RRT
source_evidence: Overlap-weighted causal RR for AKI Stage ≥1 comparing preop SGLT2i exposure vs no exposure was 1.12 (95% CI 0.80–1.55), prevalence 35% vs 30%.

outcome_definition: AKI Stage ≥1 within 7 days post-surgery by KDIGO creatinine criteria
source_evidence: Before weighting, AKI grade 1 or more occurred in 36/117 (31%) exposed vs 137/392 (35%) unexposed.

outcome_definition: AKI Stage 3 within 7 days post-surgery by KDIGO creatinine criteria
adjustment_variables: Overlap-weighted propensity score using: LVEF category, chronic arterial hypertension, COPD, BMI, preoperative hemoglobin, preoperative serum creatinine, loop diuretic, renin–angiotensin system inhibitors, surgery type, simplified prediction index for RRT
source_evidence: Overlap-weighted causal RR for AKI Stage 3 comparing preop SGLT2i exposure vs no exposure was 0.87 (95% CI 0.33–2.32), prevalence 4% vs 5%.

outcome_definition: AKI Stage 3 within 7 days post-surgery by KDIGO creatinine criteria
source_evidence: Before weighting, AKI grade 3 occurred in 4/117 (3%) exposed vs 21/392 (5%) unexposed.

outcome_definition: AKI defined as serum creatinine ≥0.3 mg/dL (26.2 µmol/L) or 1.5–2-fold increase from baseline within 48 hours after OPCABG
source_evidence: After PSM, AKI occurred in 54/403 (13.4%) with dapagliflozin vs 373/1209 (30.9%) in controls; AKI defined by creatinine change within 48 hours.

outcome_definition: As defined in Methods; analysis after PSM
source_evidence: Table reports OR 0.347 (95% CI 0.254–0.474) for AKI comparing dapagliflozin vs no dapagliflozin after PSM.
extraction_notes: Table notes indicate logistic regression; adjustment variables not specified.

outcome_definition: Cardiac surgery–associated AKI (CSA-AKI) within 7 days per KDIGO creatinine criteria (stages 1–3).
source_evidence: CSA-AKI occurred in 23.0% (31/135) of SGLT2i users vs 28.1% (98/349) of non-users.

outcome_definition: CSA-AKI within 7 days per KDIGO; effect from weighted logistic regression using entropy balancing.
adjustment_variables: Entropy balancing weights achieving balance on: year of operation, EuroSCORE II, sex, height, weight, age, smoking status, hypertension, chronic lung disease, prior stroke/TIA, dyslipidemia, preoperative creatinine, history of T2DM, history of HFrEF, preoperative anemia; weighted logistic regression.
source_evidence: Weighted marginal risk ratio 0.63 (95% CI 0.44–0.91; p=0.014) favoring SGLT2i.

outcome_definition: CSA-AKI within 7 days per KDIGO; effect from weighted logistic regression using entropy balancing.
adjustment_variables: Entropy balancing weights on prespecified baseline covariates; weighted logistic regression.
source_evidence: Weighted marginal risk difference −0.117 (95% CI −0.199 to −0.035; p=0.005).

outcome_definition: CSA-AKI within 7 days per KDIGO; sensitivity analysis additionally conditioning on perioperative factors.
adjustment_variables: Entropy balancing weights plus adjustment for perioperative factors: vasoactive support, any blood product transfusion within 24 h, hypotension ≥10 min with MAP <65 mmHg within 24 h, preoperative catheterization within 72 h, aortic cross-clamp time.
source_evidence: Sensitivity model RR 0.66 (95% CI 0.46–0.95; p=0.027).
